name: Challenger TLR

origin.basis: Hutchinson was founded in 1853 in Châlette-sur-Loing, France, and has made bicycle tires since 1890 (company history).

manufacturing.basis: Hutchinson's reference table marks the tubeless-ready sizes as Made in France.

positioning: Hutchinson's protected tubeless-ready training and ultra-endurance tire with Hardshield and an Endurance Bi-Compound.
hookless_note: Hutchinson's hookless page lists Challenger tubeless-ready sizes from 28 mm as compatible with hooked and hookless rims within maximum pressures; the 25 mm size is not included.
weight_basis: Hutchinson reference weights (±7%) for the 127 TPI Hardshield version.

availability.note: Hutchinson lists dealers rather than an online price; regional retail availability was not checked in this pass.

caveats: The reference table also lists a 66 TPI 28 mm tubeless-ready version at 385 g under a duplicate reference number.
No official price; Hutchinson sells through dealers.

image.shown: Challenger as pictured on Hutchinson's product page; Hutchinson shows this photo for the tubeless and tube-type versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Hutchinson Challenger road tire with textured tread and sidewall logo on a carbon rim

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.
